Neo Evolution
Double Breaker
■ Whenever one of your Neo Creatures attacks, you may add the top card of your deck to your shields face down.
■ Whenever one of your creatures would leave the battle zone, if they would go anywhere other than your graveyard, they stay in the battle zone instead.
